verses.text: The word of the LORD that came to Hose'a the son of Bee'ri, in the days of Uzzi'ah, Jo'tham, A'haz, and Hezeki'ah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jerobo'am the son of Jo'ash, king of Israel.
So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Dibla'im, and she conceived and bore him a son.
And on that day, I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezre'el.”
She conceived again and bore a daughter. And the LORD said to him, “Call her name Not pitied, for I will no more have pity on the house of Israel, to forgive them at all.
But I will have pity on the house of Judah, and I will deliver them by the LORD their God; I will not deliver them by bow, nor by sword, nor by war, nor by horses, nor by horsemen.”
And the LORD said, “Call his name Not my people, for you are not my people and I am not your God.”

And the people of Judah and the people of Israel shall be gathered together, and they shall appoint for themselves one head; and they shall go up from the land, for great shall be the day of Jezre'el.
Say to your brother, “My people,” and to your sister, “She has obtained pity.”
“Plead with your mother, plead—
lest I strip her naked
Upon her children also I will have no pity,
For their mother has played the harlot;
Therefore I will hedge up her way with thorns;
She shall pursue her lovers,
And she did not know
Therefore I will take back
Now I will uncover her lewdness
And I will put an end to all her mirth,
And I will lay waste her vines and her fig trees,
And I will punish her for the feast days of the Ba'als
“Therefore, behold, I will allure her,
And there I will give her her vineyards,
For I will remove the names of the Ba'als from her mouth, and they shall be mentioned by name no more.

And I will make for you a covenant on that day with the beasts of the field, the birds of the air, and the creeping things of the ground; and I will abolish the bow, the sword, and war from the land; and I will make you lie down in safety.
And I will espouse you for ever; I will espouse you in righteousness and in justice, in steadfast love, and in mercy.
I will espouse you in faithfulness; and you shall know the LORD.
“And in that day, says the LORD,
and the earth shall answer the grain, the wine, and the oil,
and I will sow him for myself in the land.

And the LORD said to me, “Go again, love a woman who is beloved of a paramour and is an adulteress; even as the LORD loves the people of Israel, though they turn to other gods and love cakes of raisins.”
So I bought her for fifteen shekels of silver and a homer and a lethech of barley.
And I said to her, “You must dwell as mine for many days; you shall not play the harlot, or belong to another man; so will I also be to you.”
For the children of Israel shall dwell many days without king or prince, without sacrifice or pillar, without ephod or teraphim.
Afterward the children of Israel shall return and seek the LORD their God, and David their king; and they shall come in fear to the LORD and to his goodness in the latter days.
Hear the word of the LORD, O people of Israel;
there is swearing, lying, killing, stealing, and committing adultery;
Therefore the land mourns,
Yet let no one contend,
You shall stumble by day,
My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge;
The more they increased,
They feed on the sin of my people;
And it shall be like people, like priest;
They shall eat, but not be satisfied;
Wine and new wine
My people inquire of a thing of wood,
They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains,
I will not punish your daughters when they play the harlot,
Though you play the harlot, O Israel,
Like a stubborn heifer,
E'phraim is joined to idols,
A band of drunkards, they give themselves to harlotry;
A wind has wrapped them in its wings,
Hear this, O priests!
And they have made deep the pit of Shittim;
I know E'phraim,
Their deeds do not permit them
The pride of Israel testifies to his face;
With their flocks and herds they shall go
They have dealt faithlessly with the LORD;
Blow the horn in Gib'e-ah,
E'phraim shall become a desolation
The princes of Judah have become
E'phraim is oppressed, crushed in judgment,
Therefore I am like a moth to E'phraim,
When E'phraim saw his sickness,
For I will be like a lion to E'phraim,
I will return again to my place,
“Come, let us return to the LORD;
After two days he will revive us;
Let us know, let us press on to know the LORD;
What shall I do with you, O E'phraim?
Therefore I have hewn them by the prophets,
For I desire mercy and not sacrifice,
But at Adam they transgressed the covenant;
Gilead is a city of evildoers,
As robbers lie in wait for a man,
In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing;
For you also, O Judah, a harvest is appointed.
when I would heal Israel,
But they do not consider
By their wickedness they make the king glad,
They are all adulterers;
On the day of our king the princes
For like an oven their hearts burn with intrigue;
All of them are hot as an oven,
E'phraim mixes himself with the peoples;
Aliens devour his strength,
The pride of Israel witnesses against him;
E'phraim is like a dove,
As they go, I will spread over them my net;
Woe to them, for they have strayed from me!
They do not cry to me from the heart,
Although I trained and strengthened their arms,
They turn to Ba'al;
Set the trumpet to your lips,
To me they cry,
Israel has spurned the good;
They made kings, but not through me.
I have spurned your calf, O Samar'ia.
in Israel?
For they sow the wind,
Israel is swallowed up;
For they have gone up to Assyria,
Though they hire allies among the nations,
Because E'phraim has multiplied altars for sinning,
Were I to write for him my laws by ten thousands,
They love sacrifice;
For Israel has forgotten his Maker,
Rejoice not, O Israel!
Threshing floor and winevat shall not feed them,
They shall not remain in the land of the LORD;
They shall not pour libations of wine to the LORD;
What will you do on the day of appointed festival,
For behold, they are going to Assyria;
The days of punishment have come,
The prophet is the watchman of E'phraim,
They have deeply corrupted themselves
Like grapes in the wilderness,
E'phraim’s glory shall fly away like a bird—
Even if they bring up children,
E'phraim’s sons, as I have seen, are destined for a prey;
Give them, O LORD—
Every evil of theirs is in Gilgal;
E'phraim is stricken,
My God will cast them off,
Israel is a luxuriant vine
Their heart is false;
For now they will say:
They utter mere words;
The inhabitants of Samar'ia tremble
Yes, the thing itself shall be carried to Assyria,
Samar'ia’s king shall perish,
The high places of A'ven, the sin of Israel,
From the days of Gib'e-ah, you have sinned, O Israel;
I will come against the wayward people to chastise them;
E'phraim was a trained heifer
Sow for yourselves righteousness,
You have plowed iniquity,
therefore the tumult of war shall arise among your people,
Thus it shall be done to you, O house of Israel,
When Israel was a child, I loved him,
The more I called them,
Yet it was I who taught E'phraim to walk,
I led them with cords of compassion,
They shall return to the land of Egypt,
The sword shall rage against their cities,
My people are bent on turning away from me;
How can I give you up, O E'phraim!
I will not execute my fierce anger,
They shall go after the LORD,
they shall come trembling like birds from Egypt,
E'phraim has encompassed me with lies,
E'phraim herds the wind,
The LORD has an indictment against Judah,
In the womb he took his brother by the heel,
He strove with the angel and prevailed,
the LORD the God of hosts,
“So you, by the help of your God, return,
A trader, in whose hands are false balances,
E'phraim has said, “Ah, but I am rich,
I am the LORD your God
I spoke to the prophets;
If there is iniquity in Gilead
( Jacob fled to the land of Ar'am,
By a prophet the LORD brought Israel up from Egypt,
E'phraim has given bitter provocation;
When E'phraim spoke, men trembled;
And now they sin more and more,
Therefore they shall be like the morning mist
I am the LORD your God
It was I who knew you in the wilderness,
but when they had fed to the full,
So I will be to them like a lion,
I will fall upon them like a bear robbed of her cubs,
I will destroy you, O Israel;
Where now is your king, to save you;
I have given you kings in my anger,
The iniquity of E'phraim is bound up,
The pangs of childbirth come for him,
Shall I ransom them from the power of Sheol?
Though he may flourish as the reed plant,
Samar'ia shall bear her guilt,
Return, O Israel, to the LORD your God,
Take with you words
Assyria shall not save us,
I will heal their faithlessness;
I will be as the dew to Israel;
his shoots shall spread out;
They shall return and dwell beneath my shadow,
O E'phraim, what have I to do with idols?
